cases.name: a-failed-receipt-cited
cases.omission: none: the opaque receipt records TestGreetName FAILED and the map cites it

cases.name: a-failed-receipt-labelled-runner
cases.omission: none: the same map with the receipt row relabelled corvint-test-runner-receipt/0

cases.name: a-narrowed-inventory
cases.omission: the go-test plan's expectedTests and selectors name only TestGreetEmpty although the target defines TestGreetName

cases.name: b-failed-rerun-omitted-whole
cases.omission: a failed run's receipt row, artifact and link digest are all left out, so the bytes equal a map with no failed run

cases.name: b-receipt-row-omitted
cases.omission: the node-test receipt row is left out while criterion 1 still names it

cases.name: b-receipt-link-omitted
cases.omission: criterion 1's link digest is left out, so the node-test receipt covers no criterion

cases.name: b-receipt-artifact-omitted
cases.omission: the node-test receipt artifact entry is left out

cases.name: c-selection-narrower-than-affected
cases.omission: the map records no affected plan; corvint affected --base over the recipe selects unit go:example.com/greet whole, whose advisory go test has no -run filter and so runs TestGreetName, while the go-test plan selects only TestGreetEmpty
